standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement to preservation of the algebraic subcategories by constructions A and B.

core_obligations: Reduce via the Stacks localization lemma to: constructions A and B preserve the subcategories of algebraic stacks.
Construction A: if X = [U/R] then the construction produces X' = X viewed over S'.
Construction B: if X' = [U'/R'] over S', the morphism p: S -> S' induces morphisms U' -> S and R' -> S of algebraic spaces, and X = [U'/R'] viewed over S.
The two constructions invert each other on presentations; the remaining 2-isomorphism bookkeeping is mechanical and carried as an explicit obligation.
proof_roadmap: Reduction to subcategory preservation; construction A on presentations; construction B on presentations; inversion bookkeeping.
difficulty_reason: Both preservation directions are explicit constructions on presentations; the inversion bookkeeping is mechanical.
